ceu: ✦ The opposition between the Moon and Saturn at {H:1822386285000}

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
From {H:1822412726000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between relationships and your image. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
From {H:1822412726000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between routine and your inner life. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
From {H:1822412726000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between romance and friendships. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
From {H:1822412726000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between family and your career. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
From {H:1822412726000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
From {H:1822412726000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between money and intimacy. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
From {H:1822412726000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between your image and relationships. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
From {H:1822412726000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
From {H:1822412726000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between friendships and romance. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
From {H:1822412726000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between your career and family. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
From {H:1822412726000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
From {H:1822412726000}, the Moon moves into {S:7} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The opposition between the Moon and Saturn creates some tension between intimacy and money. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.
